'''October 2004 Fort Worth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on Saturday 23 October 2004 at Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director. It was held as Jeff Braiser's last tournament before he went into the military.<ref name="pcf-4033-54929">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54929#54929 Texas Tournament for Jeff Braiser], Michael Richards, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101094823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4033%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 October 2004, 12:00 PM<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />
* '''Structure:''' Swiss, constructed, unlimited card pool; two or three rounds and no final confrontation<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />

The prizes included four uncut sheets.<ref name="pcf-4033-54929" />
